newsitem.title: UK: NATIONWIDE SEES NO NEED TO ACT YET ON RATES.
newsitem.headline: NATIONWIDE SEES NO NEED TO ACT YET ON RATES.

text.p: Britain's largest building society the Nationwide said on Thursday it sees "no need to act in haste" on its mortgage and savings rates following the Bank of England decision to raise its key money market rate.
"We are already extremely competitive on mortgage and savings rates," Nationwide told Reuters.
Nationwide's standard variable mortgage rate currently stands at 7.85 percent.
With a "typical" bank's mortgage rate at 8.20 percent, Nationwide saw no need to act until a clearer picture had emerged on what other mortgage lenders intended to do, the building society said.
The Bank of England earlier raised its key money market rate to 7.0 percent from 6.75 percent.
